objective: Remove the published exponent-bit-dependent modular-exponentiation schedule from the Level-I production Cornacchia route without a legacy fallback.

failure_contract.invalid_or_out_of_range_modulus: return fatal to the Cornacchia adapter
failure_contract.cornacchia_fatal_action: fail-stop; never retry through the legacy implementation
failure_contract.valid_level_i_expectation: the compiled 492-bit bound makes the fatal width guard unreachable for a conforming production invocation

compatibility.valid_protected_signatures: must be byte-identical to the baseline for frozen seeds
compatibility.rng_consumption: must be byte-identical to the baseline for frozen seeds
compatibility.status: must be identical to the baseline for valid inputs

required_evidence: direct protected-vs-legacy sqrt and Cornacchia differential tests
alias, no-root, domain rejection, canary, and workspace-clear tests
twelve-seed Sign signature and post-RNG differential
absence of accepted-path edges to ibz_pow_mod and ibz_mul_mod_positive
fixed exponent-loop and multiplier-loop bounds in the target object
claims_withheld: protection of Tonelli-Shanks loop counts, non-residue search, Cornacchia retries, Euclid/half-GCD, or the rest of Sign
resistance to the published key-recovery attack without analog traces and an exponent-recovery attempt
